Description.Value:
NEW CAMPAIGNS ONLY: adds a NEW, fully usable weapon - the Vulture SR - to the Phoenix base storage.
Requires the ContentTool mod. Nothing to run: ticking this mod on publishes its model keys. Equip it, holster it, overwatch, reload and fire: stats, slots, ammo, sound and muzzle flash are cloned from the PX Sniper Rifle, and it takes the same clips. NOTHING is written into your game files - the model is served from this mod's own bundle, and switching the mod off removes the weapon. NEW CAMPAIGNS ONLY: it is added to the starting storage, so an existing save will not have it. It cannot be researched or manufactured.
